title: EGWord Ver 2.00
overview:
EGWord Ver 2.00 is the digital camera compatible edition of the Japanese word processor for the Sega Saturn. Write documents on your TV and print them out at home with the included Canon BJC-240J printer.

The set comes complete with the software disc, the printer, a printer interface and an extension video cable. The Sega Saturn Keyboard and Sega Saturn Floppy Disk Drive are supported.
